front.source_observation: Complete NW overview: four storeys, north sign panel, NW L stair, west 1+2+4 circles, and full higher south core visible; continuous main roof edge.

rear.source_observation: Complete SE overview: higher south service mass and schematic central connection; east low-confidence cladding pattern is distinct from north/west.

west.source_observation: Upper-floor north-to-south circular grouping 1+2+4 preserved, with glass breaks and NW open stair zone; lower-floor pattern generalized from stronger upper-floor evidence.

east.source_observation: Circular opaque panels and glazed zones retained at schematic confidence, not mirrored north or exact copied west. Far-side windows visible through material are not extra facade geometry.

south.source_observation: Low-detail higher grey service mass, sparse approximate recesses, and central connection return; second enclosed stair represented inside the solid service volume.

north.source_observation: All three inter-storey sloping stair flights are legible through NW glazing; north entrance and tall central opaque panel remain distinct.

top.source_observation: Near-square plain main roof and separate narrow south service roof; no old-library roof garden, PV, or unsupported equipment.

entry-detail.source_observation: Deliberate detail crop verifies real north entry and coarse L-stair/platform expression behind physical glazing; no claim of exact stair treads or interior reproduction.

roof-detail.source_observation: Deliberate detail crop shows higher south service core against lower main roof and the western circle rhythm; not a full-building crop test.
